Decisions

Settled choices. Items marked LOCKED do not change without a version bump.

Topology (LOCKED)

  • Two repos: anonysec/OVManager (panel) and anonysec/OVNode (node agent), independently tagged. Wire contract v3 couples them.
  • One panel drives many nodes over TLS with pinned node certs. Ports are defaults only: panel 2095, node 2083, OpenVPN 1194.
  • Installers fetch from main; versions pin via OVM_VERSION / OVN_VERSION. --build is clone-and-build only, panel only.
  • Node ships bare-metal only. Docker is a non-goal.

TLS policy (LOCKED)

Public TLS identity by component.
ComponentPublic TLSWhy
PanelBuilt-in ACME (Let's Encrypt domain or IP) with automatic renewal, or a custom pair via ovmanager tls installOperators need browser-trusted HTTPS without installing another ACME client; the panel terminates TLS itself.
NodeSelf-signed + pinned fingerprintControl plane; one panel owns it; ACME never serves the node.
Reverse proxyNot supportedThe panel terminates TLS and does not trust forwarded headers; a proxy would break origin checks and client-IP attribution.

Versioning

  • Wire contract v3 couples panel and node. Both carry ContractVersion = 3.
  • Panel product version line reset to 2.0.0 (2026-11-02). Installers fetch from main.

Safety features (LOCKED)

  • 25-second undo. User and node deletes are restorable within 25 seconds via the banner (Undo + ✕). After that the snapshot expires (410 Gone). Node restore re-inserts the node row only.
  • Keep-last-user. The final account cannot be deleted (catastrophic-misconfig protection).
  • Restore = verify → swap → rollback. PRAGMA user_version is stamped into the restored file; too-new pools refuse with a typed error.

Database & migrations

  • Fresh install and migrated schema must match (PRAGMA table_info diff = ∅), guarded by TestFreshSchemaMatchesMigratedSchema.
  • settings_kv keys are registry-validated; unknown keys are rejected.
  • Reserved node_usage keys are exactly {push_hash, __epochs, __reseed} in one file.

OVManager is MIT-licensed. Pairs with OVNode.
